regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is concentrated in narrow, defensive/income-oriented groups (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend Blue Chips) but the rotation structure is NOT one-narrative (breadth 29% eligible, absorption 0.45, directional false). The only validated edge here (gate_helps true) is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate, not return forecasting; momentum rank is an attention lens only. Hong Kong is the market and the state does not support a clean scorable-ETF view for the leaders, so this desk note leans deliberately low and sparse.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) — the challenger at rank 2, eligible, durability_bar 0.71, hurst_tag trend — CLOSES the rotation margin toward Banks or overtakes it as the leader. Momentum rank is attention-only, so this is a leadership-flow watch, not a buy signal.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks (H + HK) is the current momentum leader (rank 1, durability_bar 0.62, breadth 0.846) and absolute-trend eligible, plus the headline leg of the detector. The trend-gate leg — the only validated edge in this market — is the basis: when eligible and durable, the discipline's staying-power leg favours remaining exposed rather than anti-trend positioning. The crowding flag (crowding_z 1.15, crowded true) is a SIZE-DOWN caution only per guardrails, never a fade, so the lean stays overweight but modest.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.413 (attention/focus leg, not alpha)
absolute-trend eligible true (the validated drawdown/shake-out gate)
durability_bar 0.62 with breadth 0.846 (cohesion supports staying power)
hurts_tag mean-revert (suggests trend-chop risk, hence low conviction)
theses.dissent: hurst_tag is mean-revert — a leader with mean-reverting character can roll over quickly once the flow attention shifts, and crowding_z 1.15 means positioning is already extended; the one validated edge only reduces drawdown, it does not forecast continuation.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips sits in the top cluster (rank 3, score 1.103, breadth 0.75, durability_bar 0.68) and is absolute-trend eligible. In a narrow, no-one-narrative Hong Kong tape, income-oriented blue chips function as a defensive holding that stays on the trend-gate. Because its crowding is low (0.35, not crowded), there is no sizing-down caution, making it a cleaner hold than the crowded leader.
